teachers.name: Sabrina Hew
teachers.bio: Founder of Master Artist and an international recording artist, with recordings and concert performances across the United States. These days her passion is helping children and adults find their own voice, musically and in art, and that is a large part of why Master Artist exists.

teachers.name: Cheong Chui Yen
teachers.bio: Trained in fine arts, with years of experience teaching drawing and painting, from young children through to adults. Technique first, always taught with patience.

teachers.name: Ana Castro
teachers.role: Baking instructor · vegan baker from Colombia

teachers.name: Alden
teachers.bio: Founder of WaffleBox Productions, with years of experience shooting graduations, events, food and products. Alden has an eye for turning everyday moments into images worth keeping, and loves sharing it with anyone curious enough to pick up a camera.

teachers.name: Zimin
teachers.bio: Behind the camera and in the edit, Zimin brings a filmmaker's eye to every project, turning raw footage into stories worth watching, and helps students find their own visual voice.
